Summaries keep the source wording. did_you_know facts are either Wikipedia "Did you know" hooks (text only, reformatted) or one-sentence rewordings of existing entries (prefixed with the date, possibly shortened). did_you_know.fact: On April 13, 1960: The United States launches Transit 1-B, the world's first satellite navigation system.
On April 13, 1742: The first performance of the oratorio Messiah by George Frideric Handel (pictured) took place in Dublin.
On April 13, 1964: At the Academy Awards, Sidney Poitier becomes the first African-American man to win the Best Actor award for the 1963 film Lilies of the Field.
April 13 is observed as April 13 (Eastern Orthodox liturgics).
On April 13, 2025: Rory McIlroy wins the Masters Tournament, becoming just the sixth person to complete the Grand Slam in golf.
